paragraphs: Rav Menashya bar Gada: Sukkah 13b, in Rav Huna’s time.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Sukkah13b scalar explicitly has Rav Menashya bar Gada reporting Rav Huna. In Rav Huna’s time remains Hyman’s supplied chronological characterization, rather than a new proof of direct acquaintance or a merged identity.
